facts.text: Drop Dead Ned offers himself and his killer wasp for hire at 100 gold for the week, as long as he gets to kill people with the wasp; he would give back 5 gold for each killing he is allowed, provided he can do what he wants with the victims.

classification.support_basis: Ned would add a hired killer and his wasp to the party's strength against the dragon, but his stated interest is killing people and nothing shows the wasp would work on a dragon.
classification.action_basis: Ned explicitly offered his services for hire at a stated price to Dr. Uriah, who is considering it; the party is pursuing a dragon kill where an added fighter is a straightforward capability-to-need match.
classification.opening_basis: Trigger: paying Ned 100 gold for the week. Benefit: a hired killer with a killer wasp joins the party, adding lethal force toward killing the dragon; the link is a capability-to-need match, weakened by Ned's condition that he kill people.
